rules.openings: One playable prologue per power signature. These are hero/student perspective events; never just a renamed tutorial.
rules.lairs: One villain-exclusive tactical location per stable villain identity; must include a phase-changing environment, meaningful secret and showdown against a lieutenant.
rules.lieutenant: One named second-in-command per villain above one-hit species, 4 HP initial benchmark, separate from minor species captain and any other permanent hero.

opening.title: The Last Order
opening.inciting: Grease fire traps the cook behind a locked delivery hatch.
opening.powerUse: Redirect heat through the kitchen hood to make a cool rescue lane.
opening.choice: Save the staff immediately or salvage the proof of an insurance scam.

lair.title: The Underwriters' Furnace
lair.venue: Insurance exchange built inside an abandoned municipal incinerator
lair.arena: Sprinkler valves switch protection from one row to another, turning yesterday's safe route into the ignition path.
lair.objective: Break the policy press before it issues citywide fire claims.
lair.secret: Charred menus reveal customers being billed for fires not yet started.

lieutenant.name: Vera Vellum
lieutenant.look: Fireproof adjuster in soot-black opera gloves and a suit stitched with red insurance ribbons.
lieutenant.power: Forecloses an ally's cover then turns that tile into a delayed fireburst.
lieutenant.counter: Her giant red approval stamp must touch a wall; destroy it or disrupt the stamp.
lieutenant.agenda: Cares for the restaurant workers whose livelihoods Backdraft calls collateral.

opening.title: Ferris Wheel Without Air
opening.inciting: Passengers pass out in stalled observation cars as the wheel spins against the wind.
opening.powerUse: Shape a stable air corridor between suspended carriages.
opening.choice: Choose the lowest gondola first or risk everyone to reach the child at the top.

lair.title: The Quiet Vault
lair.venue: Suspended vacuum chambers beneath an elite bank
lair.arena: Airlocks cycle oxygen between pods; moving quickly is unsafe unless pressure is equalized.
lair.objective: Open the emergency intake before the vault's final pressure drop.
lair.secret: Maintenance logs prove Skyline could have left every innocent depositor breathing.

lieutenant.name: Dr. Serein Voss
lieutenant.look: Vacuum physician with translucent glass lungs and a surgeon's silver mask.
lieutenant.power: Creates a two-cell low-pressure zone that suppresses shooting and drags nearby cover.
lieutenant.counter: The lung pumps visibly refill between pulses; sever their hose to end suction.
lieutenant.agenda: Will betray Skyline if promised evacuation for patients in the adjoining hospital.

opening.title: The Street That Sank
opening.inciting: A school bus lists into a fresh sinkhole while the street beneath it keeps moving.
opening.powerUse: Raise a temporary earthen ramp without collapsing an old water main.
opening.choice: Save passengers now or keep the neighborhood's fragile water system intact.

lair.title: The Deed Below
lair.venue: Old Quarry sub-basement and occupied tunnel court
lair.arena: Burrowing warning rings appear behind cover; heavy support pillars can collapse new or old exits.
lair.objective: Stop the underground title auction before the surface buildings are repossessed.
lair.secret: Tunnel plans show which tenants Cornerstone deliberately protected.

lieutenant.name: Mags Hardpan
lieutenant.look: Seismic drummer in granite shoulder plates, dragging a bass drum carved from quarry stone.
lieutenant.power: Beats the floor to create chained cracks and pushes units between elevations.
lieutenant.counter: A missing downbeat exposes the resonant drumhead for interruption.
lieutenant.agenda: Protects the Warren Wreckers' union contract and refuses unsafe tunnel orders.

opening.title: Hydrant Blue
opening.venue: Municipal fire station during a heat wave
opening.inciting: Firefighters discover every hydrant is bone-dry with residents still trapped by smoke.
opening.powerUse: Lift and redirect water from a broken underground main.
opening.choice: Flood the engine bay for immediate rescue or ration enough for the next block.

lair.title: The Empty Reservoir
lair.venue: Dry cistern with enormous inverted water columns and pressure gates
lair.arena: Pressure bridges fill and drain on a three-beat cycle, opening and closing firing lanes.
lair.objective: Release captive neighborhood supply before Tidewarden seals the aqueduct.
lair.secret: A hand-marked overflow channel could save the district without yielding to ransom.

lieutenant.name: Solene Spigot
lieutenant.look: Tide-cartographer in a glass diving bell, carrying a rotating brass pressure sextant.
lieutenant.power: Moves entire watery lanes sideways, sweeping units into exposed ground.
lieutenant.counter: Turn the red depth wheel against her sextant to freeze the current.
lieutenant.agenda: Believes water is a right, despite her role collecting the extortion payments.

opening.title: The Clocktower Collapse
opening.venue: School clocktower crowded with graduation banners
opening.inciting: The hands jam while a maintenance platform falls on a timed sequence.
opening.powerUse: Use precisely timed movement to catch the falling lift between gear teeth.
opening.choice: Rescue the technician or preserve the live timing evidence from the sabotage.

lair.title: The Ninety-Second Palace
lair.venue: Circular subway dispatch clock and twelve moving platforms
lair.arena: Every third beat swaps doors and rotating cover, rewarding players who count time.
lair.objective: Stop The Second Hand's synchronized city heist before the final chime.
lair.secret: His master plan leaves ninety-three seconds unaccounted for.

lieutenant.name: Adjutant Tempo
lieutenant.look: Tall metronome fencer with paired conductor batons and a clockwork spine.
lieutenant.power: Grants nearby henchmen a synchronized extra action at the chime.
lieutenant.counter: Break one baton to desynchronize the formation until the next round.
lieutenant.agenda: Secretly schedules recovery time and refuses to make casualties part of the plan.

opening.title: The Equation That Escaped
opening.inciting: An experimental proof escapes a whiteboard and unfolds into dangerous autonomous drones.
opening.powerUse: Reconfigure one faulty drone to build an emergency shield instead of attacking.
opening.choice: Publish the error that caused this or privately patch it before people panic.

lair.title: The Red Pen Engine
lair.venue: Labyrinthine aerial drone printer above Comet City's computing vault
lair.arena: Conveyors shift each turn; failed equations are projected onto the squares they will explode.
lair.objective: Stop Eureka's final optimization from deleting living neighborhoods.
lair.secret: An intentionally preserved error reads PLEASE LEAVE ROOM FOR PEOPLE.

lieutenant.name: Professor Minus
lieutenant.look: White-coated ex-teacher with blackboard forearms and rotating chalk halo.
lieutenant.power: Subtracts one AP from targets inside a visible red correction rectangle.
lieutenant.counter: Smear the chalk cornerstone to collapse the attack equation.
lieutenant.agenda: Wants Eureka's work recognized, but opposes turning students into variables.

opening.title: The Unlicensed Rescue
opening.venue: Public library where a benefit concert loses power
opening.inciting: A private hero franchise security team demands a license before evacuating families.
opening.powerUse: Use a signature cape maneuver that works even when a legal force field blocks it.
opening.choice: Protect anonymous volunteers or accept a public sponsorship contract.

lair.title: The Franchise Citadel
lair.venue: Corporate Hall of Heroes with spinning neon trademarks
lair.arena: Legal seal tiles disable named special powers while unbranded cover remains usable.
lair.objective: Seize the original volunteer rescue ledger before it is shredded.
lair.secret: Founding deeds prove the city's earliest cape heroes donated their symbols freely.

lieutenant.name: Counsel Galatea Gilt
lieutenant.look: Corporate knight in holographic robes, powered by a floating notarization desk.
lieutenant.power: Redlines one hero action each round and projects a courtroom shield on an ally.
lieutenant.counter: Read the displayed clause and use an action it doesn't prohibit.
lieutenant.agenda: Wants trademarks to fund public defenders, not Captain Valcourt's monopolies.

opening.title: The Song That Stopped
opening.venue: Community radio tower during a blackout
opening.inciting: A backup broadcast loops a sponsor jingle that turns listeners into a crowd.
opening.powerUse: Create an improvised counter-melody to guide people out of the crush.
opening.choice: Silence all radio or restore a risky channel for emergency messages.

lair.title: The Sponsorship Cathedral
lair.venue: Stadium backstage converted to a cathedral of synchronized advertising screens
lair.arena: Singing towers link across the map and relay attacks; breaking formation weakens the chorus.
lair.objective: Disconnect the sponsored volunteer recruitment feed.
lair.secret: An unsigned jingle gives the audience instructions for breaking its own trance.

lieutenant.name: Maestro Nix Vale
lieutenant.look: Androgynous broadcast conductor in mirrored headphones and an LED-lined cape.
lieutenant.power: Coordinates a multi-tile vocal wave that slides allied targets into new firing lines.
lieutenant.counter: Mute one exposed studio monitor to break the harmonic chain.
lieutenant.agenda: Resents the contracts that make audiences property, despite enjoying their adoration.

opening.title: Ashes of the Ledger
opening.venue: City clinic with endangered mutant medical records
opening.inciting: Officials threaten to burn a clinic's confidential patient charts after a raid.
opening.powerUse: Burn a safe escape hole through reinforced doors without igniting the records.
opening.choice: Expose the illegal registration registry or protect patients' immediate privacy.

lair.title: The Nameless Archive
lair.venue: Fire-blackened registration hall lined with blast-proof rolling shelves
lair.arena: Paper-ash smoke blinds long sightlines while pressurized vents periodically reverse airflow.
lair.objective: Recover the family memory index before Ashborn burns every copy.
lair.secret: A hidden list records successful reunions made possible by carefully kept names.

lieutenant.name: Cinder Tern
lieutenant.look: Heat-born archivist with copper wings made of stitched blank pages.
lieutenant.power: Scatters hot paper shards that pin two targets while smoke hides her movement.
lieutenant.counter: The shard pattern can be broken by turning on the ceiling fans.
lieutenant.agenda: She believes history must survive even when the government records must not.

opening.title: The Balcony Witness
opening.venue: School assembly hall and roof garden
opening.inciting: A messenger bird arrives with evidence just as a hidden sharpshooter fires at it.
opening.powerUse: Redirect a flock through open windows to protect the witness.
opening.choice: Publicly reveal the blackmailers or keep the informant safe at a cost.

lair.title: The Crooked Aviary
lair.venue: Vertical apartment towers joined by secret bird bridges
lair.arena: Crows shuttle objective keys to high perches while blind spots rotate at each alarm.
lair.objective: Intercept the blackmail ledger before its citywide release.
lair.secret: An unsigned letter reveals Kestrel has protected some young witnesses.

lieutenant.name: Madam Rookwire
lieutenant.look: Spymaster in a feather-collared coat with telescoping talons and stained-glass lenses.
lieutenant.power: Splits into mirrored silhouettes at three window perches to issue a coordinated attack.
lieutenant.counter: The real silhouette casts a moving shadow; break the correct perch.
lieutenant.agenda: Collects secrets to defend whistleblowers, not to sell every victim twice.

opening.title: Bridge of Last Chances
opening.venue: Condemned footbridge carrying families to shelter
opening.inciting: A landlord's demolition charges begin their countdown while the bridge is still occupied.
opening.powerUse: Reinforce failing spans with living stone and absorb the next collapse.
opening.choice: Rescue the last family or chase the demolition foreman with the evidence.

lair.title: The Eviction Fault
lair.venue: Seismic platform beneath the luxury tower's foundation
lair.arena: Shockwave pillars rise and fall, shattering static cover and changing elevation.
lair.objective: Stop Groundswell's punitive collapse from crushing the tenants as well as their landlord.
lair.secret: The legal parcel map shows most tenants were never complicit.

lieutenant.name: Kiln Marshal Brack
lieutenant.look: Living concrete ex-inspector with reinforced joints and a surveyor's prism.
lieutenant.power: Stomps a cone of shifting rubble that converts full cover to half cover.
lieutenant.counter: Interrupt the prism beam before the stomp locks onto its tiles.
lieutenant.agenda: Will switch sides if the squatters' evacuation route is genuinely protected.

opening.title: A Ship With No Port
opening.venue: Harbor ferry loaded with displaced families
opening.inciting: Port security turns away a damaged ferry while a storm closes in.
opening.powerUse: Shape a temporary seawall to keep the ferry afloat through rough channels.
opening.choice: Save its engines or negotiate docking rights for everyone aboard.

lair.title: The Container Throne
lair.venue: Flooded customs terminal stacked with floating metal containers
lair.arena: Tides move container cover between lanes and armor plates expose weak joints.
lair.objective: Release ships held for ransom before Harbormaster sinks the navigation buoys.
lair.secret: Dockmaster's log proves an entire neighborhood was never offered a berth.

lieutenant.name: Commander Saltscale
lieutenant.look: Crab-armored former dock pilot in a barnacle crown with mechanical harpoon arms.
lieutenant.power: Anchors two targets together and drags the nearer one through rising water.
lieutenant.counter: Sever the visibly taut tow rope before the pull resolves.
lieutenant.agenda: Demanded safe harbor for mutants long before the boss demanded payment.
